svg.title: Existing regressions are reused, not re-added
svg.desc: The parent already contains the zero-check, warning-option, relative-input and consumer-initialization tests. The migration adapts their setup. Gray code is baseline coverage, not tests added by this migration. Direct inputs() tests construct an explicit module; build() retains its short provider adapter.
